wireContract: Superset of 0.71.0 and main's 0.68.6. It carries the HNS root-import lifecycle projection that 0.68.6 added (optional lifecycle block with phase, bounded pending reason, deadline with kind, server time, observation summary, next_check_at with retry hint, permitted actions) alongside 0.71.0's PreflightSongVideoInterval operation. The song-video operations are unchanged from 0.71.0; the added fields are optional and older shapes remain valid. The rebase onto 4b9e84e6 merged the 0.68.6 client change that 0.71.0's immutable artifact predates, so a new release was required.
